master: Wide 16:9 panoramic background for an isometric toy city-builder game. Style: bright, clean, stylized plastic toy-brick world, soft gradients, gentle ambient occlusion, cheerful saturated colors, like a premium kids' building-toy game backdrop. Not photorealistic. No text, no logos, no brand marks, no people. Scene: the view beyond the edge of {CITY}: {BACKDROP}. Composition: sky fills the top half. A thin horizon band at 45-60% height shows {SKYLINE}, small and slightly hazy with atmospheric perspective. The lower 40% is {FOREGROUND}, calm, fading to a soft out-of-focus blur at the bottom center (a game board will sit there). Keep 10% empty margin at the left and right edges. Time: clear midday, soft white clouds.

edits.golden: Edit the attached image. Keep the composition, camera, and every shape exactly identical, with the skyline in the same place. Change only the lighting to golden hour: a low warm sun near the horizon, an orange-pink sky, long soft shadows, and windows catching the light.

edits.overcast: Edit the attached image. Keep the composition, camera, and every shape exactly identical, with the skyline in the same place. Change it to an overcast day: flat soft grey clouds covering the whole sky, no sun, muted colors, slightly lower contrast, and wet-looking water. No rain streaks (the game adds weather itself).
